headline: Nigerian Industrial Sector Lowers Foreign Exchange Demand by $1 Billion
summary: Nigeria’s foreign exchange utilization by the industrial sector fell by $1 billion in the first half of the year due to increased local sourcing.
why: Foreign exchange demand by domestic manufacturers serves as a key indicator of import dependence and industrial activity in emerging market economies.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Reduced industrial foreign exchange demand eases pressure on central bank reserves and stabilizes local currency liquidity.
